description: This file contains unit tests for the ClientDirectory class in an Orleans-based distributed system. It tests local and remote client lookup functionalities, handling of silo status changes, and propagation of client route updates.

classes.name: ClientDirectoryTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of ClientDirectory, including local and remote client lookups, silo status updates, and route propagation.

methods.name: TryLocalLookupTests
methods.description: Tests the local lookup functionality of ClientDirectory for existing and non-existing clients, including clients hosted on remote silos.

methods.name: LocalLookupTests
methods.description: Asynchronously tests the lookup of clients locally within the ClientDirectory.

methods.name: RemoteLookupSuccessTests
methods.description: Verifies that the ClientDirectory correctly queries remote silos for client routes and updates its local state accordingly.

methods.name: RemoteLookupFailureTests
methods.description: Ensures that the ClientDirectory continues to function correctly even when remote lookups fail due to timeouts or exceptions.

methods.name: PublishChangesSuccessTests
methods.description: Tests the propagation of client route updates to remote silos, including handling silo failures and route synchronization.

methods.name: Silo
methods.description: Helper method to parse a string into a SiloAddress.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Helper method to create a GrainId for a client based on a string identifier.

methods.name: SetLocalClients
methods.description: Sets the list of local clients in the test environment and updates the version.
